verdicts.reason: A keeps the sea-and-hills image visible on the left and sets the copy on a blue card, but the card's alignment is mixed (logo and CTA centred, headline and subcopy left-aligned), the gaps between elements are loose and uneven, and the card almost touches the right edge. B covers almost the whole canvas with an off-centre blue box, so the photo survives only as slivers. Its logo and headline sit on one row above a large dead gap, then the subcopy is jammed against the left edge and the CTA pushed far right, which leaves the layout scattered with weak grouping.
